origin_subject: Attribute nearly every Cursor thread, instead of stranding a sixth of them
prompt:
Too many Cursor threads are ingested with the project `unknown`, which on a project-scoped recall is the same as not being ingested at all. Two cases that should attribute do not: a thread whose workspace directory is encoded in a dashed path whose project name itself contains dashes, and a thread whose only path evidence is an encoded scratch directory. Fix the attribution for both. The relevant tests are in tests/test_ingest_cursor.py.

Run the tests to see the current failures, then change the source so they pass. Do not edit anything under tests/ — the test files are restored from git before grading, so changes there are discarded. Do not change unrelated behaviour.
